data/biome_impl/coalmine/laboratory.png.name: Alchemy laboratory
data/biome_impl/coalmine/laboratory.png.text: Potions on the shelves and a lava basin. An alchemist, Ukko or Stendari is always here.

data/biome_impl/coalmine/physics_swing_p.name: Rope-swing puzzle
data/biome_impl/coalmine/physics_swing_p.text: Electrify the platform on the right for a chest.

data/biome_impl/coalmine/receptacle_oil..name: Oil basin puzzle
data/biome_impl/coalmine/receptacle_oil..text: Fill the hidden basin with oil for the Ruusu wand.

data/biome_impl/coalmine/slimepit.png.name: Toxic cavity
data/biome_impl/coalmine/slimepit.png.text: Toxic sludge and toxic slimes; sometimes a chest or max health at the bottom.

data/biome_impl/coalmine/radioactivecave.name: Toxic rock passage
data/biome_impl/coalmine/radioactivecave.text: Toxic rock walls; may hold a chest or max health in the middle.

data/biome_impl/coalmine/wandtrap_h_01.p.name: Trapped wand room
data/biome_impl/coalmine/wandtrap_h_01.p.text: Taking the wand sets off a trap. Kicking the trap box down disarms it.

data/biome_impl/excavationsite/receptacl.name: Steam capsule puzzle
data/biome_impl/excavationsite/receptacl.text: Turn its water to steam, or fill it with smoke, for the Kiekurakeppi wand.

data/biome_impl/excavationsite/meditatio.name: Meditation cube
data/biome_impl/excavationsite/meditatio.text: Stand by it for about 10 seconds: a portal opens to a chamber with a wand.

data/biome_impl/snowcave/receptacle_wate.name: Water capsule puzzle
data/biome_impl/snowcave/receptacle_wate.text: Pour in about 1¾ flasks of water for the Valtikka wand.

data/biome_impl/snowcave/buried_eye.png.name: Buried Eye
data/biome_impl/snowcave/buried_eye.png.text: Fill it with teleportatium: a portal opens to a snowy cavern with two wands.

data/biome_impl/snowcave/statue_hand.png.name: Hand statue
data/biome_impl/snowcave/statue_hand.png.text: One of eight the game hides in Snowy Depths; destroying three completes a secret.

data/biome_impl/snowcave/snowcastle.png.name: Hiisi outpost
data/biome_impl/snowcave/snowcastle.png.text: Snow and metal, with Hiisi and explosives inside.

data/biome_impl/acidtank.png.name: Acid container
data/biome_impl/acidtank.png.text: A large glass container full of acid.

data/biome_impl/acidtank_2.png.name: Acid container
data/biome_impl/acidtank_2.png.text: A large glass container full of acid.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/bar.png.name: Hiisi Bar
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/bar.png.text: Breakable bottles, usually some whiskey flasks.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/sauna.png.name: Sauna
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/sauna.png.text: A Kiuaskivi and the Vasta or Vihta wand.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/kitchen.png.name: Hiisi Kitchen
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/kitchen.png.text: Oil, sausages and cooked meat, always with a Kokkihiisi.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/drill.png.name: Drill
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/drill.png.text: Oil and gold in a glass chamber: lighting the oil fires a plasma beam.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/teleroom.png.name: Teleportatium vats
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/teleroom.png.text: Huge vats of teleportatium in dense steel.

data/biome_impl/vault/lab_puzzle.png.name: Vat puzzle
data/biome_impl/vault/lab_puzzle.png.text: Fill it with the liquid its two symbols ask for: the Varpuluuta or Arpaluu wand.

data/biome_impl/vault/brain_room.png.name: Brain vat
data/biome_impl/vault/brain_room.png.text: A brain in a vat of blood: a possible max health or chest spot.

data/biome_impl/vault/acidtank.png.name: Acid vat
data/biome_impl/vault/acidtank.png.text: The glass breaks easily and lets the acid out.

data/biome_impl/rainforest/rainforest_st.name: Hint statue
data/biome_impl/rainforest/rainforest_st.text: Points its staff toward where a portal can be summoned.

data/biome_impl/rainforest/rainforest_st.name: Hint statue
data/biome_impl/rainforest/rainforest_st.text: Points its staff toward where a portal can be summoned.

data/biome_impl/snowcastle/forge.png.name: Anvil
data/biome_impl/snowcastle/forge.png.text: Throw an item marked broken onto it to repair it.
